claude_only.name: Which single meta-object does this control assertion govern, and does that reference resolve to a canonical instance rather than a copy or a class?
Is the object susceptible to exclusive control, or does it exist as indefinitely reproducible copies with no authoritative instance?
Does control extend to the whole object or only to a defined part, aspect or bundle of it?
If the object is an aggregate, is control asserted over the aggregate, over each member, or over both with different holders?
Which identifier authority governs this control record: an authoritative master register, a governed global IRI, or a locally minted UUID/ULID?
Which prior version does this record supersede, and is the superseded version still resolvable?
Does this new version correct an error in the prior record or record a real-world change of control?
Which control modality does this record assert — legal title, beneficial interest, custody, administrative controllership, or de-facto technical control?
Do several modalities over this object coexist with different parties, and are they recorded as separate assertions rather than merged?
Does the asserted modality carry a transferable right, or only accountability without any proprietary claim?
If the modality is unknown, is the record held as unclassified rather than defaulted to legal title?
What legal, contractual, customary or administrative ground creates this control, and is it original or derivative?
Which source documents evidence the basis, and what is their type and reliability?
Is recording in this register constitutive of the control, or merely declaratory of a control that exists independently?
If the basis is customary, communal or informal, is it recorded as legitimate rather than as an absence of tenure?
Which parties are bound as holders of this object, and in which role does each stand?
Is the holder an individual party or a group party, and if a group, is its membership enumerated or defined by rule?
Does every party reference resolve in the person or organization model, and what happens when one does not?
If no holder can currently be identified, is the object recorded as holder-unknown with a search obligation rather than left with a stale holder?
Who ultimately benefits from or controls this object behind the party of record, and through which intermediate chain?
Is any party of record acting as a nominee, trustee or custodian for another, and is that fact disclosed on the record?
How recently was the beneficial-holder information verified, and by what method?
Who may see the beneficial-holder layer, given that general public access to such data has been held disproportionate?
What exact fraction does each co-holder hold, and do the fractions sum to unity for the recorded extent?
Is the co-holding joint (undivided, with survivorship) or several (divided into distinct shares)?
What threshold of co-holders is required to dispose of, encumber or delegate the object?
Where responsibility rather than value is shared, how is it allocated between the parties and where is that allocation published?
What restrictions, security interests or charges currently qualify this holding, and who benefits from each?
In what priority order do competing encumbrances rank, and on what basis is that rank determined?
Does this encumbrance block, condition or merely notify a transfer of control?
What event releases the encumbrance, and is release recorded as a separate assertion?
What responsibilities attach to holding this object, and are they duties of the holder, of a steward, or of both?
How is discharge of each responsibility evidenced, and what is the consequence of non-discharge?
When the named owner leaves a role or the object is transferred, what triggers timely reassignment of the responsibility?
Which objects currently carry responsibilities with no assigned bearer?
Which party is appointed steward or custodian, over which extent of the object, and by whose authority?
What may the steward do only on instruction, and what may it decide independently?
What happens if a steward determines purposes and means of its own, rather than acting on instruction?
For what term does the appointment run, and what must the steward do on termination — return, transfer or destroy?
Which specific powers are delegated, over which object extent, and under what constraints of time, place, purpose or value?
From which control position does the mandate flow, and is every delegated power contained within that position?
May the delegate sub-delegate, to whom, and does the chain depth have a hard limit?
When the delegate acts, is the act attributed to the delegate representing the holder, or does the delegate become indistinguishable from the holder?
At the moment of reliance, what evidence shows the mandate was live, in scope and unrevoked?
When was the mandate revoked, when was that revocation published, and how large was the gap?
Are acts performed in good faith during the revocation propagation gap treated as valid, void, or voidable?
How can a mandate be verified when the issuing register is unreachable, and what assurance is lost?
Is this arrangement supported decision-making, partially substituted, or fully substituted, and why was the least restrictive option not sufficient?
Which safeguards are recorded: conflict-of-interest screening, proportionality, tailoring, and the shortest-time limit?
Which competent, independent and impartial authority reviews the arrangement, and when is the next review due?
How are the person's own will and preferences recorded and given effect within the arrangement?
Which community or governing body holds authority to control, and by what internal process is a decision reached?
Where a third party physically holds the object, does collective authority persist independently of that custody?
Is the collective authority alienable at all, and if not, how is that non-transferability enforced against downstream recipients?
What return or benefit flows back to the community from uses of the object, and how is it reported?
Which parties transfer and receive control, in which modality, and over which extent of the object?
When was the instrument executed, when did the transfer take effect, and when was it recorded?
What conditions precedent must be satisfied before the transfer takes effect, and which remain outstanding?
Is the transfer for consideration, gratuitous, or an administrative reassignment, and is that fact relevant to its reversibility?
What reliable method establishes that exactly one party is in control of this object in this modality at this instant?
How are two concurrent transfer attempts on the same object detected, ordered and resolved?
If the register forks or is replicated, which replica is authoritative and how is a divergent branch reconciled?
How is a non-authoritative copy of the object or its instrument marked so it cannot be presented as the controlled instance?
Is this transfer valid, void, voidable or subject to a pending challenge, and on what ground?
If a transfer is set aside, which downstream transfers and encumbrances are affected, and which acquirers are protected?
How is an invalid transfer corrected — by reversal entry, annulment or restitution — and is the original entry preserved?
What event opened the succession or lapse — death, dissolution, term expiry, abandonment or operation of law?
Who, if anyone, controls the object between the trigger event and the vesting of a successor?
By what rule does control vest in the successor, and when does vesting take effect relative to the trigger?
Before declaring abandonment or lapse, what diligent search was performed and over what period?
Who held this object in a given modality at a specified past instant, and on what basis?
Where does the chain have gaps, overlaps or links with no evidencing source?
What is the earliest recorded control position, and is it a genuine origin or merely the register's own start date?
For links inherited from a predecessor register or migration, what mapping and loss occurred?
What is the current state of this control assertion, and which transition produced it?
Which transitions are permitted from the current state, and who is authorised to make each?
Which states are operative for reliance purposes, and which must a relying agent refuse to act on?
What suspends a control assertion without terminating it, and what restores it?
Over what interval is this control assertion effective, and is the end open or determinate?
When was this fact observed or ingested, and how far did it lag the event it records?
Does every recorded timestamp carry seconds and an explicit UTC offset or Z, and what is the local civil-time context where it matters?
Does this record change the past, and if so what was believed true before the retroactive change?
Who issued each evidencing attestation, about which subject, and who presented it to the register?
What integrity data proves the evidencing source has not been altered since issuance?
Is the evidence independent of the party it benefits, or self-asserted?
Does the evidencing source itself expire or require renewal, and what happens to the control record when it does?
What assurance level does this control assertion carry, and what evidence and verification method produced it?
When was the assertion last verified, and by what date does it become stale for reliance purposes?
For informal, customary or unregistered holdings, how is low assurance recorded without implying the holding is invalid?
Which claims over this object are irreconcilable, and in what respect do they conflict?
Is there a stated priority rule between the competing claims, and what does it yield?
While contested, which operations on the object are frozen, permitted or permitted only with notice?
How is a resolution ingested from the dispute forum, and what does it change in the control record?
Which authority maintains this register, over which object classes, modalities and territory?
What does an entry in this register confer — constitutive effect, a rebuttable presumption, or evidence only?
How are records outside the register's competence marked, and what may an agent infer from them?
Where two registers claim competence over the same object, which prevails and how is the conflict surfaced?
Which audience tiers may read which layers of the control record, and what is the default for an unclassified requester?
How is a requester's legitimate interest established and recorded before privileged disclosure?
What is the minimum disclosure that satisfies a given purpose — current holder only, or the full record?
Which reads are logged, with what detail, and for how long is the read log kept?
How long is each class of control record retained, and what legal or operational basis sets that period?
When a party exercises an erasure or rectification right, which elements can be removed and which must survive as an anonymised or tombstoned link?
How is chain integrity preserved when an intermediate record is redacted or tombstoned?
On decommissioning of the register, who takes custody of the historical control records and under what terms?
For each external standard, which elements of this model map, which map only partially, and which have no counterpart?
Where does an external standard's semantics conflict with this model's, and which prevails in an export?
Is a conformance claim to any external standard being made, and what test evidence supports it?
What export shape lets a holder move their control records to another system in a structured, machine-readable form?

grok_only.name: Which subject object, of which kind, is this registry entry the control unit for, and which master-system identifier is authoritative?
On what registration basis was the entry opened, at what event time, and when was that fact observed or ingested?
What reliable method identifies this record as the unique control object, keeps it capable of control until cessation, and preserves integrity against duplicate claims?
If no registry entry exists, is there a recorded legitimate unregistered tenure claim, and is it classified as a claim rather than as registered title?
Who are the current holder parties of this registry entry, and is each recorded as owner, rightsHolder, custodian or another CI_RoleCode?
What is the basis of title, from when is it effective, and is the binding current, superseded, disputed or annulled?
Is the recorded holder distinct from the creator, publisher or originator of the object, and which identifiers prove that distinction?
Who is authorised to read this title extract, and which competent-authority or holder-granted exception applies?
Is this holding public, private, communal, indigenous, customary, informal or mixed, and who is the community holder if the form is collective?
From when until when may the holders use or control the object, and under what conditions?
Is this a registered title, a legitimate unregistered claim, or a contested claim, and which source supports that class?
Which parties hold which fractions of this title, and do the fractions sum to one, leave an open remainder, or fail a sum check?
May any one co-holder exercise the whole right, or must they act jointly, and does survivorship apply?
Is any named shareholder a nominee, who is the nominator, and is a bearer form still outstanding?
When did the last share restructure occur, and which instrument authorised the change of fractions or parties?
Which natural persons ultimately own or control this object or its holding vehicle, and through ownership interests, control or other means, or both?
Do legal owners and beneficial owners differ, and which nominees, layered persons or bearer forms sit between them?
When was beneficial-ownership information last confirmed adequate, accurate and up to date, and is a discrepancy report open?
Which competent authorities, financial institutions or other lawful recipients may access this beneficial-ownership record, and at what cost or restriction?
Who is the settlor, who are the trustees, who are the beneficiaries or what is the purpose, and is the trustee also a beneficiary?
Do the assets constitute a separate fund that is excluded from the trustee's personal, insolvency, matrimonial and death estates, and where is that ring-fence recorded?
Which law governs the trust, was it chosen by the settlor or selected by closest connection, and is recognition refused under Article 13?
What powers and duties does the trustee have to manage, employ or dispose, to delegate, to create security interests, and to account, and how is the trustee removed?
Who is appointed to operate this object, for which holder, under which role code, and on what appointment basis?
What duties bind the steward, from when until when, and to whom must the steward account?
Does the appointment confer beneficial ownership, or only custody and care, and how is conversion of the asset into the steward's estate prohibited?
What significant changes of custody, as distinct from changes of ownership, are recorded for authenticity and integrity?
Which person is identified as in exclusive control of this record, by which reliable method, and is exclusivity actually exclusive or a declared joint-control regime?
From creation until cessation, has the record remained capable of control, and has integrity been preserved apart from authorised changes?
Does the person in control hold legal title, beneficial ownership, a mere bailee's possession, or an undetermined substantive right, and which other law decides that?
When control last transferred, what event time and observation time were recorded, and did the transfer meet MLETR transfer-of-control equivalence?
Who granted which named powers over which object to whom, and under which parent ownership record?
What constraints limit the mandate, is it still unrevoked and unexpired, and may the assignee sub-delegate?
Do any granted powers exceed the live parent title, including after a transfer or restriction that narrowed the holder's own powers?
Before honouring an act, can a counterparty verify that the claimed powers exist, are in scope, satisfy constraints, and are unrevoked?
Which entities can currently make changes to the DID document, and is the DID subject among them?
Which delegates may use which verification methods, and are they forbidden to update the DID document?
Is this DID controller relation bound to a legal ownership record, and if not, has any agent treated cryptographic control as title?
Is this arrangement supported decision-making, substitute guardianship, mixed, or minority parental authority, and who remains the holder of record?
Which holdings and decisions are in scope, which safeguards against abuse apply, and when must the arrangement be reviewed?
May the supporter or guardian execute a transfer of the principal's holdings, and is that authority derived from this arrangement or from a separate mandate?
Do HCCH Article 15 mandatory rules on minors or incapable parties, or a CRPD-implementing statute, constrain recognition of a related trust or transfer?
Which parties conveyed which rights in which objects to whom, and under which instrument identifier?
Which conditions precedent remain, when was the instrument executed, when was that observed, and is title rewrite still blocked?
Did exclusive control of the electronic record move with legal title, only one of them, or neither, and is that split intentional?
If a transferor lacked capacity or is a ward, which arrangement authorised the conveyance?
What event opened succession on these holdings, when, and which former holder is affected?
Who are the successors, did survivorship apply, and do mandatory forced-heirship rules reshape the instrument?
Did operational cryptographic control follow the legal successors, remain with a surviving controller, or become irrecoverable?
What exceptional event affected which holdings, what is the effect on title, and which authority ordered it?
In which jurisdiction is this event class recognised, and is it a universal mixin class or a tagged local doctrine?
Does a good-faith third-party or insolvency-creditor rule under HCCH Article 15 defeat or qualify this holding or this trust?
Which restriction or responsibility qualifies this title, who imposed it, and what action does it forbid or oblige?
From when until when is the qualification effective, and which constraints refine it?
If this is a security interest, where do priority and enforcement live, and what is stored here besides existence of the burden?
Which sources support this title or beneficial-ownership fact, and what is their verification status?
Is this holding recorded as registered, verified, discrepant, contested or unknown, and has anyone claimed indefeasibility without a cited instrument?
What significant ownership and custody changes are needed to interpret authenticity and integrity of this object?
Which law governs this holding or trust, was it chosen or selected by closest connection, and what is the situs of the assets or administration?
Are administration or other severable aspects governed by a different law, and which mappings apply?
Which HCCH Article 15 mandatory categories (minors, marriage, succession, security interests, insolvency, good faith) override the chosen law for this object?
Through which national policy or statute, if any, are VGGT tenure principles applied to this object?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
